description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorResponseAdapter' that maps ErrorResponse objects to and from an Adaptable, handling JSON parsing, error registry integration, and topic path construction within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AbstractErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that provides mechanisms to convert ErrorResponse objects to and from Adaptable representations, including JSON parsing, error registry handling, and topic path management within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: parseWithErrorRegistry
methods.description: Parses an error JSON object using an error registry, returning a DittoRuntimeException, or a generic one if parsing fails.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an ErrorResponse of type T by extracting headers, topic path, and payload, and parsing the error JSON.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an ErrorResponse of type T into an Adaptable object, constructing the appropriate topic path, payload, and headers based on the error response and channel.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a TopicPathBuilder for a given error response.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to construct an ErrorResponse object from a topic path, exception, and headers.
